feature: Export Preferences
inp: No Quick Export format, destination (ask / next to document), metadata or colour-space preferences.

feature: Camera Raw preferences (defaults, sidecar XMP, cache, DNG and JPEG/TIFF handling, performance)
inp: The Camera Raw filter (/home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/develop-ui.js) has no preferences, raw defaults or presets storage.

feature: Cursors: Other Cursors (Standard / Precise), Brush Preview colour, brush leash colour
inp: No options for non-painting cursors or preview colours.

feature: Enhanced Controls (Microsoft Dial, Touch Bar)
inp: No hardware control support.

feature: File Handling: File Compatibility (Camera Raw preferences, prefer Camera Raw for raw files, Ignore EXIF profile tag, Ignore Rotation Metadata, Ask Before Saving Layered TIFF, Disable PSD compression, Maximize PSD and PSB Compatibility)
inp: No such options; EXIF orientation is always applied by the browser decoder and PSDs always carry a composite.

feature: File Handling: Image Previews, File Extension case, Save As to Original Folder, Enable legacy Save As, do not append 'copy'
where: Preferences > File Handling: File Saving Options
inp: No such options; .pigment always stores a thumbnail and Save a Copy always appends ' copy'.

feature: General: Color Picker (Adobe or system) and HUD Color Picker
inp: Only Pigment's own picker; no system picker choice and no HUD picker.

feature: General: Export Clipboard
inp: Copies always go to the system clipboard as PNG; there is no switch to keep large copies internal.

feature: General: Auto show the Home Screen, Use Legacy New Document Interface, Beep When Done
inp: The welcome screen always shows with no document; no completion sound; one New Document dialog.

feature: Guides, Grid & Slices: guide colours and styles (canvas, artboard, smart guides)
inp: 0.4: guide colour and style (Lines, Dashed Lines) and the Smart Guides colour in Preferences › Guides, Grid & Slices; every guide also has its own colour. Artboard guides wait for artboards (0.9)

feature: Guides, Grid & Slices: Slices (line colour, show slice numbers) and Path options
where: Preferences > Guides, Grid & Slices: Slices, Paths
inp: No slices; path outline colour and thickness are fixed.

feature: History Log (save to metadata, text file or both; Sessions Only, Concise, Detailed)
inp: No edit log is written anywhere.

feature: Interface: canvas colour and border per screen mode (Standard, Full Screen with Menus, Full Screen, Artboards)
inp: settings.canvasBackground is defined in /home/user/claude/pigment/src/shared/defaults.js but has no UI and no reader; there are no screen modes beyond the OS full screen.

feature: Interface: Show Channels in Color, Dynamic Color Sliders, Show Menu Colors
inp: No such options.

feature: Interface: UI Language, UI Font Size, UI Scaling
inp: English only with no string catalogue; no font size or scaling control (OS zoom only).

feature: Technology Previews
inp: No experimental feature switches.

feature: Tools: Show Tooltips / Rich Tooltips, Enable Gestures, Use Shift Key for Tool Switch, Overscroll, Enable Flick Panning
inp: Tooltips are always on and Shift+letter always cycles; no gesture, overscroll or flick panning settings.

feature: Tools: Snap Vector Tools and Transforms to Pixel Grid, Show Transformation Values, Double Click Layer Mask Launches Select and Mask, Vary Round Brush Hardness based on HUD
inp: None of these options exist (Pigment adds its own 'Scale shape strokes with transforms').

feature: Transparency & Gamut: Gamut Warning colour and opacity
inp: View > Gamut Warning exists but its overlay colour and opacity are fixed.

feature: Units & Rulers: Type unit, Column Size (width, gutter), New Document Preset Resolutions (print, screen), Point/Pica Size
inp: None of these exist; type size is always in pixels.

feature: Preferences dialog structure
inp: One page with four headings (Interface, Cursors and tools, Canvas, Performance) and 17 settings in extras.js, plus Reset All Settings.

feature: Cursors: Painting Cursors (Standard, Precise, Normal Brush Tip, Full Size Brush Tip, crosshair in tip, only crosshair while painting)
inp: cursorStyle: Brush outline, Precise, Dot. No full-size tip (soft edge), no crosshair-in-tip options.

feature: File Handling: Recent File List Contains N files
inp: settings.recentLimit (20) is honoured by /home/user/claude/pigment/src/main/ipc.js but has no field in Preferences; the menu shows 15.

feature: General: Reset All Warning Dialogs, Reset Preferences on Quit
inp: Reset All Settings resets preferences, tool options, swatches, brush presets and layout at once. There are no 'don't show again' warnings to reset.

feature: General: Resize Image During Place, Skip Transform when Placing, Always Create Smart Objects when Placing
inp: 'Place files as smart objects' exists (placeAsSmart). Resize-to-fit is always on and the transform step is always skipped, with no preferences for either.

feature: Guides, Grid & Slices: Grid colour, style, Gridline Every, Subdivisions
inp: 0.4: grid colour, style (lines, dashed, dots), Gridline Every with a unit and Subdivisions; the grid starts at the ruler origin

feature: Interface: Color Theme (four brightness levels), Highlight Color, Neutral Color Mode
inp: Theme is System, Light or Dark; no intermediate greys, highlight colour or neutral mode.

feature: Performance: Memory Usage (let the app use N% of RAM)
inp: Only a per-document history memory cap (historyMemoryMB). No overall memory budget or usage readout.

feature: Tools: Animated Zoom, Zoom Resizes Windows, Zoom with Scroll Wheel, Zoom Clicked Point to Center
inp: Zoom with the scroll wheel is in Preferences. settings.animatedZoom exists in defaults.js without UI or a reader; the other two are absent.

feature: Transparency & Gamut: Grid Size and Grid Colors
inp: Small/Medium/Large and two custom colours (checkerboardSize, checkerboardLight, checkerboardDark). No 'None' and no named colour presets.

feature: General: Image Interpolation default
inp: resampleMethod (Image Size) and transformInterpolation in the Preferences dialog.

feature: General: Use Legacy Free Transform (proportional scaling by default)
inp: 'Keep proportions while transforming (Shift releases)' (transformProportional).

feature: Performance: History States
inp: historyLimit, 1 to 1000, applied to open documents at once.

feature: Units & Rulers: Rulers unit
inp: rulerUnit: pixels, inches, centimetres, millimetres, points, percent (no picas).

feature: Zoomify
inp: No tiled-pyramid export. The Zoomify viewer is third-party; a tile pyramid plus Pigment's own HTML viewer would be the substitute.

feature: Generate > Image Assets
inp: No automatic asset export from layer names (for example 'icon.png, 200% icon@2x.png').

feature: Save for Web: named presets and Optimize to File Size
where: Save for Web: Preset menu, panel menu
inp: The last settings are remembered (settings.saveForWeb) but there are no named presets and no target-file-size optimiser.

feature: Save for Web: encoder options (JPEG Progressive/Optimized/Blur, GIF Lossy/Interlaced/Web Snap, PNG Interlaced, Embed Color Profile, Metadata menu)
inp: None of these exist; 'Convert to sRGB' is a no-op checkbox because documents are sRGB already.

feature: Color Lookup Tables
inp: file:export-luts in /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/adjust-more-ui.js writes .cube and .3dl with a description and 16/32/64 grid points. Missing: .csp and ICC (abstract/device-link) output, copyright field, lowercase-extension option and Photoshop's quality range up to 256.

feature: Export As: Image Size, Scale, Resample method, Canvas Size
where: File > Export > Export As: Image Size / Canvas Size
inp: Width, height (linked) and a scale preset. No Resample menu (the canvas 'high' smoothing is always used) and no Canvas Size fields.

feature: Export As: multiple scales with suffixes, layer/artboard asset list
where: File > Export > Export As: Scale All, asset list
inp: One file per export. Selected layers have their own Export As (/home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/layers-extras/export.js) but there is no 1x/2x/3x list with suffixes and no per-asset settings.

feature: Export As: preview with zoom and 2-up comparison
where: File > Export > Export As: preview pane
inp: No preview; only a debounced 'about N KB' estimate from a real encode. Save for Web has the 2-up preview.

feature: Layers to Files
inp: file:export-layers (file-ops.js): top-level layers or groups, any flat format, Visible Layers Only, Trim, file name prefix. Missing: PSD and PDF output, per-format options (JPEG quality, PNG-8 transparency, TIFF compression), Include ICC Profile, nested layers.

feature: Quick Export as [format]
where: File > Export > Quick Export as PNG
inp: file:export-quick in /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/file-ops.js always writes PNG next to the document (asks before overwriting). The format, quality, location and metadata cannot be changed because Export Preferences does not exist.

feature: Save for Web: Color Table editing (lock, shift to web, delete, map to transparent, sort, load/save table)
where: Save for Web: Color Table panel and menu
inp: The table is shown read-only; a custom palette can be supplied through the Indexed Color fields. No per-swatch editing or .act load/save in this dialog.

feature: Save for Web: Original / Optimized / 4-Up tabs
inp: 2-up only (README limit); no single-pane tabs and no 4-up comparison of settings.

feature: Export As: formats
inp: PNG, PNG-8, 16-bit PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF and Targa with quality and per-format fields (file-ops.js exportAs). Covers Photoshop's PNG/JPG/GIF and more.

feature: Save for Web (Legacy): core optimisation
inp: /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/modes/save-for-web.js: 2-up original/optimised, GIF, JPEG, PNG-8, PNG-24 and WebP, palette type, colour count, forced colours, dither and amount, transparency, matte, image size and percent, zoom, real file size and download time, colour table display.

feature: Open: 32-bit HDR formats (OpenEXR, Radiance .hdr, Portable Bit Map/PFM)
inp: 32-bit documents exist (depth.js) but only TIFF float and .pigment carry them; no EXR/HDR/PBM readers.

feature: Open: EPS / DCS (Rasterize EPS Format dialog)
inp: No PostScript interpreter. Would need a bundled or user-installed interpreter (Ghostscript is AGPL, so user-installed helper is the honest route).

feature: Open: JPEG 2000 and JPEG XL
inp: Neither is decoded (Chromium does not decode them and no reader is registered). OpenJPEG and libjxl are open source and can be built to WASM.

feature: Open: legacy and specialist formats (DICOM, PCX, IFF, Pixar, Scitex CT, Cineon/DPX, Photoshop Raw with Raw Options, WBMP, MPO)
inp: None of these are registered in OPEN_READERS (io.js).

feature: Open: camera RAW files (DNG, CR2/CR3, NEF, ARW, RAF...) through Camera Raw
inp: No RAW decoder; the Camera Raw filter develops RGB layers only. Adobe's camera profiles are proprietary, but an open decoder (LibRaw compiled to WASM) feeding the existing develop pipeline is an honest substitute.

feature: Open: PDF and Illustrator files (Import PDF dialog: pages/images, crop to, resolution, mode, bit depth)
inp: No PDF reader. pdf.js can rasterise pages and extract images offline.

feature: Photoshop PDF save (Adobe PDF presets, compression, output, security, preserve editing capabilities)
where: File > Save As: Photoshop PDF; Edit > Adobe PDF Presets
inp: The only PDF is Chromium's print-to-PDF of one flattened page (print.js saveAsPdf). No PDF writer with presets, compression, PDF/X or passwords, and no Adobe PDF Presets manager. A local PDF writer with Pigment's own presets is the substitute for Adobe's .joboptions.

feature: Scripts > Load Multiple DICOM Files
where: File > Scripts > Load Multiple DICOM Files
inp: No DICOM reader.

feature: Open: PSD/PSB fidelity
where: File > Open (Photoshop and Large Document formats)
inp: readPsdDocument in /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/io.js reads layers, groups, raster masks, opacity, fill opacity, blend modes, clipping, locks, text (one style per layer) and 14 adjustment kinds. Not read: layer styles/effects, vector masks, shape and fill layers (arrive as pixels), smart objects and smart filters (pixels), artboards, layer comps, guides, alpha/spot channels, paths, ICC profile, 16/32-bit depth and CMYK/Lab/Grayscale modes (all become 8-bit RGB).

feature: Save As: format list
inp: Writes .pigment, PSD, PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF and Targa (SAVE_FILTERS in documents.js plus depth.js and modes/formats.js). Missing: PSB (opened but not written), BMP (read only), Photoshop PDF, EPS, DCS, JPEG 2000, JPEG XL, OpenEXR, Radiance, Portable Bit Map, PCX, DICOM, IFF, Photoshop Raw, Scitex, Pixar, Multi-Picture.

feature: Save: PSD write fidelity (and Maximize Compatibility)
inp: writePsdDocument (io.js) always writes 8-bit RGB with a composite. Kept: pixels, groups, masks, opacity, blend, clipping, locks, editable text (one style), 14 adjustment kinds, XMP. Lost: layer styles (not written and not baked in), smart objects, shapes and fill layers (rasterised), alpha/spot channels, paths, guides, 16/32-bit data, image mode. No Maximize Compatibility choice.

feature: Format option dialogs (JPEG Options, PNG Format Options, TIFF Options, WebP options)
inp: JPEG and WebP ask for quality only (documents.js lossyOptions): no matte, baseline/optimized/progressive, lossless WebP or metadata switches. PNG has no compression/interlace choice. TIFF depth and compression fields exist in Export As only; Save As to .tif asks nothing; no layered TIFF, byte order or pyramid.

feature: Open: HEIF/HEIC
inp: HEVC is patent-encumbered, so a decoder cannot be shipped freely. Substitute: use the operating system's codec where installed (macOS ImageIO, Windows HEIF extension) or a user-installed libheif.

feature: Open: common raster formats (PNG 8/16-bit and palette, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF, Targa, AVIF, SVG, ICO)
inp: io.js decodeImage plus registered readers in /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/depth.js (16-bit PNG, TIFF, TGA) and /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/modes/formats.js (GIF). Stated limits: TIFF without JPEG-in-TIFF, CCITT, YCbCr, Lab, BigTIFF, first page only; SVG is rasterised at its natural size.

feature: Browse in Bridge / Close and Go to Bridge
where: File > Browse in Bridge, File > Close and Go to Bridge
inp: No file browser. Adobe Bridge is a separate Adobe application; the honest equivalent is a built-in folder and thumbnail browser (with ratings and keywords from the File Info metadata Pigment already reads).

feature: Import > WIA Support / Images from Device (scanners and cameras)
where: File > Import > WIA Support (Windows), Images from Device (macOS)
inp: No device acquisition. Needs native platform APIs (WIA, ImageCaptureCore) through a helper; TWAIN is licence-encumbered.

feature: Open As (force a file format)
inp: Format is chosen by extension with magic-byte sniffing as fallback (io.js openDocument); the user cannot force a reader.

feature: Save As dialog options (As a Copy, Layers, Alpha Channels, Spot Colors, Notes, Use Proof Setup, Embed Color Profile)
inp: The native save dialog has no option panel; the only question is a 'will be flattened' confirmation. Nothing lets the user drop layers or channels or embed a profile.

feature: Share (send the image to another app or service)
inp: No share command. The OS share sheet (macOS share menu, Windows share contract) on an exported copy would be the offline equivalent; Pigment only has Reveal in Finder/Explorer.

feature: File Handling: Save in Background and Automatically Save Recovery Information Every N minutes
inp: Saving blocks behind a busy overlay and there is no crash recovery or autosave; settings.restoreSession and lastSession exist in defaults.js but nothing reads them.

feature: Auto-Update Open Documents (reload when the file changes on disk)
inp: /home/user/claude/pigment/src/main/watch.js and the watchFile IPC exist, but no renderer code calls watchFile or listens for file-changed, so nothing happens.

feature: Revert
inp: file:revert in /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/app.js reloads the file after a confirmation, but it replaces the document and discards its history; Photoshop records Revert as an undoable history state. F12 is not bound.

feature: Close, Close All, Close Others (with Save changes prompt)
where: File > Close / Close All / Close Others
inp: documents.js close/closeAll and files.js closeOthers; Photoshop's 'Apply to All' checkbox in the prompt is not offered (each document asks).

feature: Exit / Quit (with unsaved-changes prompts)
inp: menu.js quit role and file:quit.

feature: Open (multi-select, tabs, drag and drop, OS 'Open with', already-open files are activated)
inp: DocumentManager.openDialog/openPaths in /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/documents.js.

feature: Open Recent (list, Clear Recent File List)
inp: 15 entries in the menu, Clear Recent Files (menu.js, /home/user/claude/pigment/src/main/recent.js); also listed on the welcome screen.

feature: Open as Smart Object
inp: file:open-smart in /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/layers-extras/files.js: each file opens as its own document holding one smart object; layered files stay documents.

feature: Save
inp: documents.js save(); read-only formats and multi-layer flat files route to Save As.

feature: Save a Copy
inp: file:save-copy (documents.js saveAs with copy: true); the document keeps its path and dirty state.

feature: Transform a duplicate and step-and-repeat
where: Ctrl+Alt+T (transform a copy), Ctrl+Alt+Shift+T (transform again on a copy)
inp: Neither shortcut nor behaviour exists in keymap.js or image-ops.js.

feature: Warp: Split Warp Horizontally / Vertically / Crosswise, Remove Warp Split, Grid sizes (3x3, 4x4, 5x5, custom), Convert Warp Anchor Point, Toggle Guides
where: Edit > Transform submenu and Warp options bar
inp: The net is always the single 4x4 Bezier patch; no splits, no grid choice, no guide options.

feature: Perspective Warp
inp: PerspectiveWarp in warp.js: Layout and Warp modes, quads that snap together, Shift-click an edge to straighten. Missing: the three auto-straighten buttons (vertical, horizontal, both) and non-destructive use on a smart object.

feature: Puppet Warp
inp: PuppetWarp in /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/warp.js: Mode (Rigid, Normal, Distort), Density, Show Mesh, pins, Alt-drag rotation, remove all pins. Missing: Expansion, Pin Depth (bring forward / send backward), Rotate Auto/Fixed with a numeric angle, and it rasterises a smart object instead of staying editable.

feature: Transform > Warp: control net and presets
where: Edit > Transform > Warp; options bar Warp menu, Bend, H, V
inp: BezierWarp in warp.js with 15 presets (Arc to Twist), Bend, H and V. Missing the Cylinder preset and the Change Warp Orientation toggle.

feature: Free Transform options bar: numeric X, Y, W, H, rotation, horizontal and vertical skew, Maintain Aspect Ratio link
inp: X, Y, W%, H%, angle and one skew field. No vertical skew, and the W/H link is a preference (transformProportional) rather than a button in the bar; values are blank for a distorted quad.

feature: Free Transform: Interpolation
inp: Bicubic, Bilinear, Nearest Neighbor. No Bicubic Smoother, Bicubic Sharper or Bicubic Automatic.

feature: Free Transform options bar: reference point
where: Free Transform options bar: reference point locator and Use Relative Positioning
inp: The pivot can be dragged on the canvas, but there is no nine-point locator, no show/hide toggle and no relative positioning (delta) switch.

feature: Content-Aware Scale
inp: /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/content-aware-scale.js: seam carving with Amount, Protect (alpha channel), Protect Skin Tones, W and H. No reference point locator or relative positioning fields.

feature: Free Transform: handles and modifier keys
inp: Transform tool in /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/image-ops.js: scale, rotate (Shift snaps 15 degrees), Alt from centre, Ctrl-drag distort, Ctrl+Shift skew; pixels, selections, text, shapes and smart objects.

feature: Transform > Rotate 180, 90 CW, 90 CCW, Flip Horizontal, Flip Vertical
inp: edit:transform-rotate-180/90/-90 and flip-h/flip-v.

feature: Transform > Scale, Rotate, Skew, Distort, Perspective
inp: edit:transform-<mode> commands in image-ops.js.

feature: Transform > Again
inp: edit:transform-again replays the last matrix relative to the new bounds.

feature: Automate > Create Droplet
inp: No droplet. Equivalent: a small launcher or shortcut that starts Pigment with a batch description for the dropped files.

feature: Automate > Lens Correction (batch with lens profiles)
inp: Only the interactive Filter > Lens Correction exists. Adobe's lens profile database is licensed data; the open Lensfun database is the honest substitute for automatic profiles.

feature: Automate > PDF Presentation
inp: No multi-page PDF or slideshow output (the only PDF path is one page from the Print dialog).

feature: Data Sets as Files (variables and data-driven graphics)
where: File > Export > Data Sets as Files; Image > Variables
inp: No variables or data sets.

feature: Import > Variable Data Sets
inp: No variables.

feature: Automate > Batch
inp: lib/automate/batch.js: Set, Action, Source (Folder or Opened Files), Include All Subfolders, Override Action Open / Save As commands, Destination (None, Save and Close, Folder), File Naming with serial numbers, Errors (stop or log). Missing: Suppress File Open Options Dialogs, Suppress Color Profile Warnings, and the Import and Bridge sources. This agrees with the formats auditor's 'partial' and replaces the file-edit auditor's 'done'.

feature: Automate > Contact Sheet II
inp: /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/automate/contact-sheet.js: folder or open documents, units, size, resolution, RGB/Grayscale, flatten, across/down, columns, rows, auto-spacing, rotate for best fit, caption font and size. Missing: bit depth, colour profile, separate vertical/horizontal spacing, font style, Bridge source, save/load presets.

feature: Automate > Merge to HDR Pro
where: File > Automate > Merge to HDR Pro
inp: file:automate-merge-hdr (adjust-more-ui.js) is exposure fusion into a normal image followed by HDR Toning, with align and remove-ghosts options. No 32-bit radiance result, no EV/response-curve handling, no HDR Pro workspace (presets, edge glow, tone and detail, choice of base frame for deghosting). Users wanting a 32-bit master would notice.

feature: Automate > Conditional Mode Change
inp: file:automate-conditional-mode in /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/modes.js.

feature: Automate > Crop and Straighten Photos
where: File > Automate > Crop and Straighten Photos
inp: file:automate-crop-straighten in /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/automate.js with /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/automate/scan.js; each photo becomes a new document.

feature: Automate > Fit Image
inp: automate.js fitImage with Don't Enlarge.

feature: Automate > Photomerge
inp: /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/align-blend.js: files or open documents, Auto/Perspective/Collage/Cylindrical/Spherical/Reposition, Blend Images Together, Vignette Removal, Geometric Distortion Correction, Content Aware Fill Transparent Areas (vignette and distortion are estimated from the images, no lens profiles).

feature: Scripts > Delete All Empty Layers
where: File > Scripts > Delete All Empty Layers
inp: automate.js deleteEmptyLayers, one undo step.

feature: Scripts > Flatten All Layer Effects
where: File > Scripts > Flatten All Layer Effects
inp: automate.js flattenEffects.

feature: Scripts > Flatten All Masks
inp: automate.js flattenMasks (pixel layers with raster masks; there are no vector masks to flatten).

feature: Scripts > Image Processor
inp: batch.js imageProcessorCommand: open images or folder, same location or folder, JPEG (quality 0 to 12), PSD, PNG, TIFF with Resize to Fit, Run Action, Copyright Info. Not present: save/load settings, 'open first image to apply settings', ICC profile inclusion.

feature: Scripts > Load Files into Stack
where: File > Scripts > Load Files into Stack
inp: align-blend.js file:script-load-stack with Attempt to Automatically Align and Create Smart Object after Loading.

feature: Scripts > Statistics
inp: align-blend.js file:script-statistics with the eleven stack modes and auto-align.

feature: Fill: Scripted Patterns (Brick Fill, Cross Weave, Place Along Path, Random Fill, Spiral, Symmetry Fill)
inp: 0.4: all six in Edit › Fill › Pattern › Script; they are Pigment's own placements modelled on Photoshop's scripts, not their exact output

feature: Toggle Last State
inp: 0.4: Edit › Toggle Last State (Alt+Ctrl+Z) flips between the last two states; after an Undo or a History click it returns to the state you came from

feature: Fill shortcuts
where: Alt+Backspace, Ctrl+Backspace, Shift+F5, Shift+Backspace, with Shift to preserve transparency
inp: Alt+Backspace/Delete, Ctrl+Backspace/Delete and Shift+F5 are bound (/home/user/claude/pigment/src/shared/keymap.js). Shift+Backspace (open Fill), the Shift variants that preserve transparency and Ctrl+Alt+Backspace (fill from history) are not.

feature: Fade
inp: edit:fade in /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/adjust-ui.js offers opacity and every blend mode, but only after a filter or adjustment (the only code that sets app.lastPixelEdit). It does not work after a brush stroke, Fill, Stroke or other paint command, has no shortcut and is not recorded in actions.

feature: Fill: Blending (Mode, Opacity, Preserve Transparency)
inp: Mode (27 modes), opacity and Preserve Transparency are present. Photoshop's Behind and Clear fill modes are not.

feature: Stroke
inp: strokeDialog in edit-ops.js: width, colour, Inside/Center/Outside, mode, opacity. Needs a selection (Photoshop strokes the layer's content when there is none), no Preserve Transparency checkbox (follows the layer lock), no Behind/Clear modes.

feature: Fill: History
inp: Fills from the last saved state (history.savedSnapshot), not from the state or snapshot marked as the history source in the History panel. Noticeable to anyone using snapshots as the source.

feature: Clear
inp: edit:clear: clears the selection (background colour on a transparency-locked layer), hides on a mask, deletes the layer when nothing is selected.

feature: Fill: colour contents (Foreground, Background, Color..., Black, 50% Gray, White)
inp: fillDialog in edit-ops.js; works on layers and masks.

feature: Purge (Undo, Clipboard, Histories, All, Video Cache)
inp: edit:purge in layers-extras/files.js with confirmation; Video Cache does not apply.

feature: Undo / Redo (multiple steps)
inp: edit:undo and edit:redo in app.js; menu shows the step name; text fields and live typing use native undo.

feature: Menus (show/hide and colour menu items, menu sets)
inp: The menu template is fixed in menu.js.

feature: Search (tools, panels, menus, help, Stock) / Discover panel
inp: 0.4: Edit › Search… (Ctrl+F) finds menu commands, tools and panels and runs the chosen one; no open documents, help topics beyond the Help menu, Stock or Learn results, no Discover panel

feature: Toolbar customisation (reorder, group, hide tools; extra tools; presets)
inp: The toolbox layout is fixed in /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/toolbar.js; settings.toolboxColumns is defined but unused.

feature: Workspace: Auto-Collapse Iconic Panels, Auto-Show Hidden Panels, Open Documents as Tabs, Enable Floating Document Window Docking, Large Tabs, Narrow Options Bar
inp: Documents are always tabs in one window; there are no floating document windows or iconic panels to configure.

feature: Keyboard Shortcuts editor (sets, application menus, panel menus, tools, taskspaces, conflict warnings, Summarize)
inp: shortcutsDialog in app.js is a read-only table of the built-in keys. Nothing can be rebound, saved as a set or exported.

feature: Home screen (recent files with thumbnails, sort/filter, Learn, cloud and shared files)
where: Home screen shown with no document / File > New, Open
inp: /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/welcome.js shows New, Open, New from clipboard, quick sizes and a recent list (name and path, no thumbnails, no sort or filter). Cloud, Shared with you and Learn tabs need Adobe services.

feature: Assign Profile
inp: No document profile to assign.

feature: Color Settings (working spaces, colour management policies, conversion engine and intent, black point compensation, dither, blend RGB/text gamma, settings files)
inp: No ICC colour management: profiles are not read, converted or embedded and everything is treated as sRGB (README). Adobe's ACE engine and some bundled profiles are proprietary; LittleCMS (WASM) with freely distributable profiles (sRGB, Display P3, Adobe RGB, ECI/FOGRA CMYK) is the open substitute.

feature: Convert to Profile (basic and advanced)
inp: No profile conversion; mode changes use fixed formulas (/home/user/claude/pigment/src/shared/pixels/color.js).

feature: New Document: Color Profile
where: File > New: Advanced Options > Color Profile
inp: No ICC colour management at all; every document is treated as sRGB. Depends on the Color Settings subsystem.

feature: Print: Color Management (Printer or Photoshop manages colors, printer profile, rendering intent, black point compensation, hard proofing)
inp: No ICC handling; the flattened sRGB PNG is sent to the driver.

feature: New Document: Color Mode and bit depth
where: File > New: Color Mode (Bitmap, Grayscale, RGB, CMYK, Lab) and 1/8/16/32 bit
inp: All five modes and 8/16/32 bit are offered (extras.js MODES/DEPTHS). CMYK and Lab documents are views over RGBA pixels, not real separations (README limits), so a prepress user would notice.

feature: Presets > Export/Import Presets and Migrate Presets
where: Edit > Presets > Export/Import Presets, Migrate Presets
inp: Presets sit inside settings.json with no export or import. Migrating from an earlier Photoshop does not apply; importing Photoshop preset files is the useful equivalent.

feature: Presets > Preset Manager
inp: No central manager for brushes, swatches, gradients, styles, patterns, contours, shapes and tool presets; brushes and swatches are edited only in their panels.

feature: Photoshop preset file formats (.abr, .pat, .grd, .asl, .csh, .aco/.ase, .tpl, .atn)
where: Preset Manager and panel menus: Load / Save / Import
inp: None can be read or written; .atn is recognised only to explain that it cannot be loaded (/home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/actions/model.js). The formats are publicly documented or reverse-engineered, so readers are feasible offline.

feature: Define Pattern
inp: 0.4: Edit › Define Pattern… asks for the name and adds the pattern to the persistent pattern library

feature: Fill: Pattern with Custom Pattern picker
inp: 0.4: Edit › Fill › Pattern has the Custom Pattern picker over the pattern library, plus Scripted Patterns

feature: Render Video
inp: No Timeline, frames or video layers.

feature: Import > Video Frames to Layers
where: File > Import > Video Frames to Layers
inp: No video import. Chromium can decode common video locally, so frames to layers is buildable without a Timeline.

feature: Open: animated GIF as frames
where: File > Open (GIF opens with a frame animation in the Timeline)
inp: GIF is read and written as a single frame; there is no Timeline.

feature: Open: video files as video layers
inp: No video layers or Timeline.

feature: Save for Web: animation frames and Looping Options
inp: GIF is written as one frame; there are no frames to export.

feature: Content-Aware Fill: Fill Settings (Color Adaptation, Rotation Adaptation, Scale, Mirror)
inp: inpaint() takes only a patch size; no colour adaptation levels, rotation, scale or mirrored patches.

feature: Content-Aware Fill: Output To (Current Layer, New Layer, Duplicate Layer) and live preview panel
where: Edit > Content-Aware Fill: Output Settings, Preview
inp: Always writes into the current layer with no preview before commit.

feature: Content-Aware Fill workspace: Sampling Area (Auto, Rectangular, Custom; overlay opacity, colour, indicates), Sampling Brush, Lasso, Hand and Zoom tools
where: Edit > Content-Aware Fill: workspace and Sampling Area Options
inp: No workspace. The user cannot see or edit which pixels are sampled; the source is always a fixed margin around the hole.

feature: Fill: Content-Aware with Color Adaptation
inp: Choosing Content-Aware runs edit:content-aware-fill; there is no Color Adaptation checkbox and the dialog's mode and opacity are ignored for it.

feature: Content-Aware Fill: the fill itself
inp: /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/content-aware.js runs a patch-based inpaint (/home/user/claude/pigment/src/shared/pixels/inpaint.js) from a margin around the selection straight into the active layer. Different algorithm from Adobe's; results are comparable on textures and weaker on structure.

feature: Export As: Metadata (None / Copyright and Contact Info) and Color Space (Convert to sRGB, Embed Color Profile)
where: File > Export > Export As: Metadata, Color Space
inp: Exported files carry no XMP, EXIF or ICC profile and the dialog has no such options.

feature: File Info: metadata templates (import, export, append/replace)
where: File > File Info: Template Folder menu
inp: No .xmp template import or export.

feature: File Info: Origin, IPTC, IPTC Extension, GPS Data, Audio/Video Data, Photoshop (history log), DICOM, Raw Data
inp: Only Credit and Source from Origin. No IPTC contact/image/status fields, no GPS, no raw XMP view, no history tab.

feature: Metadata preserved in saved and exported files
where: File > Save As / Export (XMP, EXIF, IPTC carried in the file)
inp: XMP is read from JPEG, TIFF, PSD, PNG and WebP, but written only into PSD on save (file-info.js stampPsd) and into JPEG by the Image Processor. Save As or Export to JPEG, PNG, TIFF or WebP drops XMP and all EXIF, so a photo loses its camera data and copyright.

feature: File Info: Basic (title, author, description, rating, keywords, copyright status, notice and URL)
inp: properties() in file-ops.js with /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/file-info.js; undoable. Author Title and Description Writer fields are absent.

feature: File Info: Camera Data
inp: EXIF from JPEG and TIFF shown read-only (file-info.js readExif/describeExif).

feature: New Document: Saved presets (save, rename, delete custom document presets)
where: File > New: Saved tab, Save Preset button
inp: No way to save a custom document preset; only the built-in list plus Custom.

feature: New Document: Recent items and Clipboard preset
inp: A Clipboard preset appears when the clipboard holds an image and the last used settings are remembered (settings.newDocPreset). There is no list of recently used sizes.

feature: New Document: units (pixels, inches, cm, mm, points, picas; resolution in px/inch or px/cm)
where: File > New: Width/Height unit menu, Resolution unit menu
inp: Units are px, in, cm, mm only (UNITS in extras.js). No points, picas or columns; resolution is ppi only (no pixels/cm).

feature: New Document: preset categories (Photo, Print, Art & Illustration, Web, Mobile, Film & Video)
where: File > New: category tabs with blank document presets
inp: One flat select of 21 sizes (DOC_PRESETS in extras.js: screen, paper, photo, social, web, icon). No category tabs, no mobile device presets, no Film & Video presets (which also need pixel aspect ratio).

feature: New Document: name, width, height, orientation swap, resolution
inp: newDocumentDialog in /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/extras.js; limits 30000 px per side, 250 MP; memory summary line.

feature: New Document: Background Contents
where: File > New: Background Contents (White, Black, Background Color, Transparent, Custom)
inp: All five choices in extras.js, including a custom colour picker.

feature: Remote Connections
inp: No remote control service. Photoshop itself has retired this; a local, opt-in automation socket would be the equivalent if wanted.

feature: Scripts > Browse (run a script) and the scripting engine (ExtendScript, UXP)
inp: No scripting. Running Adobe .jsx or UXP scripts unmodified is not feasible (proprietary object model); the honest substitute is Pigment's own JavaScript scripting API over the command registry (/home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/commands.js), with user script files in a sandbox.

feature: Scripts > Script Events Manager
inp: No way to run an action or script on events (Start Application, Open Document, Save Document...).

feature: Plugins (UXP and legacy extension panels, Generator, filter plug-ins, plugin manager)
inp: No plugin system. Loading Adobe UXP/CEP panels or .8bf filters is not feasible (proprietary host APIs); the honest substitute is a Pigment plugin API on the existing filter, adjustment and format registries. Only 'Show all Filter Gallery groups and names' exists, inside the Filter Gallery dialog.

feature: Check Spelling
inp: No spell check for text layers. Electron's built-in Hunspell spellchecker is available offline (spellcheck is already enabled in /home/user/claude/pigment/src/main/main.js for inputs only).

feature: Find and Replace Text
inp: No search across text layers.

feature: Paste Special > Paste Without Formatting
where: Edit > Paste Special > Paste Without Formatting (while editing type)
inp: 0.4: Edit › Paste Special › Paste Without Formatting pastes plain text into a type session

feature: Type preferences (Use Smart Quotes, Enable Missing Glyph Protection, Show Font Names in English, Use ESC key to commit text, glyph alternates, Fill new type layers with placeholder text, recent fonts count, text engine options)
inp: No type preferences.

feature: Paste dialog for vector artwork (Paste As Smart Object, Pixels, Path, Shape Layer)
where: Edit > Paste (from Illustrator or SVG data)
inp: Only bitmap clipboard data is read; SVG or PDF clipboard content is ignored.

feature: Paste Special > Paste Outside
inp: Not in the menu or the registry; it is Paste Into with the inverted selection as the mask.

feature: Copy and paste of whole layers, shapes, paths and styled text between documents
where: Edit > Copy / Paste with layers selected
inp: Text, shape, fill and smart layers are copied as rasterised pixels (copyPixels renders them). There is no clipboard for layer structure, vector data or text attributes; Duplicate to another document is the only route.

feature: Cut, Copy, Copy Merged
inp: /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/edit-ops.js: pixels inside the selection to an internal clipboard and the system clipboard as PNG; works on masks.

feature: Paste (new layer, centred in view or selection; new document from clipboard)
inp: edit-ops.js paste; prefers the internal clipboard when it matches the system image.

feature: Paste Special > Paste Into
inp: edit:paste-into creates the layer with an unlinked mask from the selection.

feature: Paste Special > Paste in Place
where: Edit > Paste Special > Paste in Place
inp: edit:paste-in-place.

feature: Layer Comps to Files / Layer Comps to PDF
where: File > Export > Layer Comps to Files, Layer Comps to PDF
inp: No layer comps.

feature: Place Linked, linked smart object management (Update Modified Content, Relink to File, Embed Linked) and Package
inp: Smart objects are always embedded; there is no link to an external file, so Package (collect linked files) has nothing to do.

feature: Place Embedded
inp: file:place in /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/smart-object.js places the file as a smart object fitted to the canvas (or pixels when the preference is off) and switches to Move. It does not enter a Free Transform session to size and confirm the placement, and PDF/AI cannot be placed; SVG is rasterised rather than kept as a vector smart object.

feature: Auto-Align Layers
inp: align-blend.js: Auto, Perspective, Collage, Cylindrical, Spherical, Reposition, Vignette Removal, Geometric Distortion (estimated from the images, not from lens profiles).

feature: Auto-Blend Layers
inp: align-blend.js: Panorama or Stack Images, Seamless Tones and Colors, Content Aware Fill Transparent Areas.

feature: Performance: Graphics Processor settings (Use Graphics Processor, advanced modes, 30-bit display), multithreaded compositing
inp: Rendering is Canvas 2D with pixel code in JavaScript; no GPU pipeline or settings.

feature: Performance: Cache Levels, Cache Tile Size and the document-type optimisation presets
inp: No image pyramid or tile cache; the compositor works on full-resolution canvases (/home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/compositor.js).

feature: Scratch Disks
inp: Everything is held in RAM; no disk-backed storage for pixels or history, so very large documents are limited by memory.

feature: Print One Copy
inp: No command; print.js already stores printDefaults, so a silent print with them is small.

feature: Print Selected Area
where: File > Print: Position and Size > Print Selected Area
inp: Always prints the whole flattened document.

feature: Print: Printing Marks and Functions (crop and registration marks, description, labels, emulsion down, negative, background, border, bleed)
inp: None of these exist in the print dialog.

feature: Print: printer, copies, paper, orientation, position and size, scale to fit, preview
inp: /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/print.js and /home/user/claude/pigment/src/main/print.js: printer list, copies, paper sizes and custom, margins, fit/100%/custom scale, centre or offsets, live page preview, Save as PDF.

feature: Artboards to Files / Artboards to PDF
where: File > Export > Artboards to Files, Artboards to PDF
inp: No artboards.

feature: New Document: Artboards checkbox
inp: No artboards exist anywhere in Pigment (README 'What it does not do'). Needs the artboard layer type first.

feature: Define Custom Shape
inp: The Custom Shape tool has a fixed built-in list (/home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/tools/vector.js); a path cannot be saved as a new shape.

feature: Paths to Illustrator
inp: Paths cannot be exported. An SVG (or simple .ai-compatible PDF) writer for the Paths panel would be the equivalent.

feature: 3D preferences and 3D features
inp: No 3D (README). Adobe has itself retired Photoshop's 3D features, so this is the lowest-value gap in the area.

feature: Define Brush Preset
inp: Brush tips are parametric only (size, hardness, angle, roundness in /home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/brush.js); a selection cannot become a sampled brush tip. Needs image-tip support in the brush engine.

feature: Import > Notes
inp: No Note tool or Notes panel, so nothing to import into.

feature: Save for Web: slices, Slice Select tool, HTML output settings, Preview in browser
where: Save for Web: toolbox, Preview button, Output Settings
inp: No slices in Pigment at all; the dialog has no tools, no HTML output and no browser preview.

feature: New Document: Pixel Aspect Ratio
where: File > New: Advanced Options > Pixel Aspect Ratio (and View > Pixel Aspect Ratio)
inp: No pixel aspect ratio field in the document model or the view.

feature: Generative Fill
where: Edit > Generative Fill (and the Contextual Task Bar)
inp: AI > Generative Fill (/home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/ai/features.js) sends the selection and a prompt to the user's own OpenAI or Gemini account and adds 1 to 3 result layers. Adobe Firefly itself is not feasible. Missing versus Photoshop: generative layer with variation history in Properties, reference image, the item under the Edit menu and a contextual task bar.

feature: Sky Replacement
inp: Only AI > Replace Sky (ai/features.js): a text prompt generates a sky through the user's provider key over a heuristic or selected sky mask. Nothing of Photoshop's dialog: sky preset library and imported sky images, Shift Edge, Fade Edge, sky brightness/temperature/scale/flip, foreground lighting and colour adjustment, output as a layer group with masks. Adobe's sky model and bundled skies are proprietary; an offline version using Select Sky plus a user-supplied sky image and colour harmonisation is buildable.

feature: Image Processing (Select Subject and Remove Background on device or cloud, generative Remove tool, Firefly model choice)
inp: These choose between Adobe's device models and Adobe's cloud. Pigment's counterpart is the AI Accounts dialog (/home/user/claude/pigment/src/renderer/lib/ai/accounts.js) for provider and model, with local heuristics for Select Subject and Sky; an open segmentation model the user downloads would be the closest device-side substitute.

feature: Invite to Edit / Share for Review
where: File > Invite, File > Share for Review
inp: Requires Adobe cloud documents and accounts. No substitute beyond exporting a file.

feature: New Document: templates from Adobe Stock
inp: Needs Adobe Stock servers and licensed template files. Honest substitute: a local templates folder of .pigment/.psd files offered in the dialog.

feature: Cloud documents (Save to Creative Cloud, PSDC, offline availability)
where: File > Save / Save As: Save to cloud documents
inp: Needs Adobe's cloud storage. Local .pigment files are the substitute; a user-chosen synced folder works with any cloud drive.

feature: Search Adobe Stock
inp: Adobe Stock service and licensing. No substitute planned.

feature: Version History
inp: Photoshop's versions live with cloud documents. Substitute: local numbered versions or snapshots stored inside the .pigment container or beside the file.
